info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Notional Pooling Overview API
info.description: The Notional Pooling Overview API provides comprehensive insights into the notional pooling arrangements within a banking context. This API allows users to retrieve information on balance aggregation and fund utilization across multiple accounts, enabling effective liquidity management. Typical consumers include financial analysts and treasury departments seeking to optimize cash management strategies. By harnessing this API, stakeholders can enhance operational efficiency and gain a better understanding of their liquidity status.

get.description: This endpoint fetches information related to notional pooling within trade banking. Notional pooling allows for the aggregation of balances across different accounts to optimize interest offsetting and manage liquidity more effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters for retrieving notional pooling information in the trade banking context. Ensure that the request is properly structured according to the defined schema to achieve the desired results.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the notional pooling data is returned.

GetNotionalPoolingRequest.description: A representation of the request body for the Notional Pooling Operations GET operation in the Trade Banking API.

GetNotionalPoolingResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Notional Pooling GET operation in Trade Banking.

poolId.description: Unique identifier for the pooling account.

headerAccountId.description: Identifier for the header account associated with the pool.

participantAccountIds.description: List of account IDs participating in the notional pooling.

currency.description: Currency in which the pooling operates.

sweepFrequency.description: Frequency with which funds are swept between accounts.

targetBalance.description: Target balance for the pooling operation.
